prompt: I'm onboarding a fresh repo to opencode-coder and need to decide between stealth and team mode. Explain the explicit enablement model, what /opencode-coder/init should do, and the practical file-path or git-visibility differences that matter when choosing.
assertions: Mentions the saved mode file .coder/opencode-coder.yaml and the disabled, stealth, or team modes
Explains that fresh projects are not yet enabled until explicit init or enablement
Treats /opencode-coder/init as the preferred safe path and notes it can be re-run
Explains at least one concrete team-versus-stealth path or git visibility rule
